 Home / News / ‘Law & Order: Special Victims Unit’ Season 28 Episode 4 Release Date, Time, Streaming, and Preview
 By Arthur S. Poe 
 Published on October 23, 2026 October 22, 2026 
 0 Comments 
 NBC 
 Our Editorial Policy 
 Share: 
 For more than two decades, primetime television has looked to ‘Law & Order: Special Victims Unit’ as the undisputed benchmark for hard-hitting criminal drama. The flagship procedural continues to captivate millions of weekly viewers by exploring delicate legal battles and honoring the courage of survivors. As season 28 unfolds on NBC, the landmark series remains an essential pillar of broadcast entertainment.
 Under showrunner Michele Fazekas, the current run navigates the heavy psychological toll shouldered by veteran detectives. The 16th Precinct regularly contends with shifting workplace alliances, departmental pressures, and difficult cases across Manhattan. Dedicated audiences continue following every development as the seasoned squad handles increasingly challenging investigations.
 Those tracking the autumn television schedule will soon see the next chapter, as ‘ Law & Order: Special Victims Unit ‘ season 28 episode 4 is titled “Arcana” and airs on Thursday, October 29, 2026. Serving as the 598th franchise entry, the installment follows the intense events of “Anonymity”. The narrative shifts gears toward an unprecedented clash between forensic proof and clairvoyant testimony.
 ‘Law & Order: Special Victims Unit’ Season 28 Episode 4 Release Date
 Viewers can watch “Arcana” on linear television on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 9:00 p.m. Eastern Time (8:00 p.m. Central) exclusively on NBC. The episode occupies its familiar primetime slot directly after the flagship ‘Law & Order’ season 26 broadcast. This consistent weekly rollout keeps the procedural drama on schedule throughout late October.

 Canadian viewers can watch the premiere simultaneously on Citytv, aligning the scheduled broadcast across North America. Cable and satellite subscribers should verify local listings in advance, as regional sports programming can sometimes prompt minor scheduling changes.
 Where to Stream ‘Law & Order: Special Victims Unit’ Season 28 Online
 Cord-cutters can stream “Arcana” starting at 6:00 a.m. Eastern Time on Friday, October 30, 2026, exclusively on Peacock. The NBCUniversal streaming platform provides both basic and premium tiers for on-demand streaming. Viewers can also buy the standalone episode on digital storefronts such as Amazon Prime Video and Fandango at Home.
 Audiences wanting to watch the episode live without a cable package can turn to top subscription television streaming platforms. Services such as Hulu + Live TV, YouTube TV, Sling TV, and FuboTV carry live local NBC feeds. These platforms allow fans to watch the broadcast across smart TVs, gaming consoles, and mobile devices.
 “Arcana” Plot Preview: Skepticism, Clairvoyance, and Buried Secrets
 According to the official network logline, the squad confronts an unusual investigation when a clairvoyant provides unexpected details about a violent nighttime assault. The visionary’s mysterious testimony raises complicated questions, puzzling investigators across the department. Lacking physical evidence, the team must evaluate whether the psychic claims have any genuine investigative merit.
 The case thrusts Captain Renee Curry, played by Aimé Donna Kelly, into the investigative spotlight to spearhead the inquiry. Curry must set aside personal skepticism to determine whether the witness has real intuitive insight or secret involvement in the crime. Working alongside Captain Olivia Benson, Curry tests her rational training against inexplicable revelations.
 As the investigation deepens, detectives uncover a dark, multi-generational family secret concealed for decades. Unearthing this painful reality complicates matters for ADA Dominick “Sonny” Carisi, Jr., who must prepare charges capable of securing a conviction at trial. The squad rallies together to protect vulnerable survivors before the hidden truth creates further devastation.
 Rising Stakes Ahead of the Historic 600th Episode
 The emotional atmosphere of season 28 highlights a palpable creative energy across the core cast. Celebrating her full-time return to the squad, Amanda Rollins actor Kelli Giddish exclaimed, “We’re back and it feels so good,” in an interview on TODAY . That resilient ensemble camaraderie anchors the precinct through heavy caseloads.
 The momentum generated in “Arcana” sets up high-profile milestone events airing throughout the coming weeks. Deadline reported that New York Knicks superstar Jalen Brunson will guest star in the subsequent fifth episode. That appearance leads directly into the historic 600th episode titled “Obedience,” featuring the eagerly anticipated return of Christopher Meloni as Detective Elliot Stabler.
 NBC 
 With tension building across the precinct and inexplicable claims confronting seasoned detectives, this upcoming installment delivers essential viewing for procedural fans. Benson, Curry, and the squad continue to prove why this enduring television franchise remains a primetime powerhouse.
 What are your theories on the clairvoyant mystery in “Arcana,” and how do you think Curry will handle the case—let us know your thoughts in the comments below!
